decisions.title: Tiered Load Classification with Mode-Dependent Operation
decisions.policy_intent: POLARIS should use authoritative load tiers: Critical, Essential / Flexible, Interruptible / Noncritical. Operational rules may vary by explicitly defined operating mode.
decisions.current_documented_requirement: Qualitative commitment to power station loads reliably; no tiering documented.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: loads.yaml defines single aggregate demand profile P_load without load tiering.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Actual station equipment and circuit-level mapping into Critical, Essential, and Interruptible tiers.
decisions.validation_required: Station operator validation of physical electrical circuits and load equipment inventory.
decisions.future_specification_required: Define circuit-level relay switching groups and mode-dependent load tier schedules.

decisions.title: Automated Tier-Based Load Shedding Queue
decisions.policy_intent: Critical loads are protected. Flexible/deferrable/interruptible loads may be curtailed or deferred following a predefined priority shedding structure.
decisions.current_documented_requirement: Qualitative goal to avoid power outages; no shedding schedule specified.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: milp.py & optimizer.yaml use c_unmet = $10,000/kWh penalty for all load equally.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact priority shedding sequence, restoration trigger thresholds, and dwell time parameters.
decisions.validation_required: Relay switching hardware speed and automated load-shed controller response time.
decisions.future_specification_required: Specify automated shedding queue logic, restoration priority rules, and chattering-prevention dwell times.

decisions.title: 100% Continuous Service Target for Critical Loads
decisions.policy_intent: The governed policy target is 100% continuous service for Critical Loads during normal governed operation.
decisions.current_documented_requirement: Qualitative requirement for high power reliability; no numerical percentage specified.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Economic trade-off against fuel via $10,000/kWh penalty; no minimum service level enforced.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Physical station hardware capability to guarantee 100% continuous service under worst-case weather stress.
decisions.validation_required: Engineering validation of generator backup, battery capacity, and worst-case renewable dropouts.
decisions.future_specification_required: Define 100% continuous critical service SLA and emergency exception reporting criteria.

decisions.title: 0 kWh Unmet Critical Load under Normal Governed Operation
decisions.policy_intent: Normal governed operation permits zero unmet Critical Load. Extraordinary emergency conditions require separately defined emergency policy.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: c_unmet = $10,000/kWh penalty in MILP objective (implementation fact, NOT policy).
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Operational triggers and logging protocols for declared emergency modes when 0 kWh becomes physically unachievable.
decisions.validation_required: Operational audit of backup power failover and emergency mode declaration protocols.
decisions.future_specification_required: Specify 0 kWh hard reliability boundary in normal MILP, plus explicit emergency fallback rules.

decisions.title: 0 Minutes Intentional Interruption for Critical Loads
decisions.policy_intent: Zero intentional interruption permitted for Critical Loads as a policy requirement. Physical hardware transfer gaps are governed separately.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: 1.0 hour timestep (dt = 1.0) in optimizer.yaml without sub-hour interruption limits.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Station physical transfer switching speed, UPS buffer duration, and equipment outage tolerance.
decisions.validation_required: Measurement of automatic transfer switch (ATS) gap and local UPS hold-up times.
decisions.future_specification_required: Formulate zero-intentional-interruption constraint and specify hardware ATS performance bounds.

decisions.title: Lexicographic / Multi-Stage Optimization with Hard Reliability Boundary
decisions.policy_intent: Critical reliability has absolute priority. Normal ops enforces Critical unmet load = 0. Remaining objectives optimized in priority order.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Single scalar composite objective with c_unmet * P_unmet soft penalty in milp.py.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact multi-stage / lexicographic MILP mathematical formulation and stage-coupling constraints.
decisions.validation_required: Solver execution speed and stability testing across multi-stage MILP formulations.
decisions.future_specification_required: Construct multi-stage lexicographic MILP mathematical formulation with hard Stage-1 reliability boundary.

decisions.title: Primary Metric: Liters Fuel Consumed; Secondary Metric: Diesel kWh Generated
decisions.policy_intent: Primary fuel metric is actual liters consumed (physical resupply constraint). Secondary metric is diesel electrical kWh generated.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Linear fuel expenditure ($0.625/kWh) + quadratic fuel curve in diesel.yaml & milp.py.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact fuel curve quadratic coefficients (a*P^2 + b*P + c*u) for converting electric output to liters across temperatures.
decisions.validation_required: Generator fuel consumption bench testing and empirical fuel flow meter calibration.
decisions.future_specification_required: Formulate diesel minimization objective in terms of liters consumed using calibrated fuel curves.

decisions.title: Seasonal Fuel Budget with Dynamic Fuel Management
decisions.policy_intent: Establish seasonal/resupply-cycle fuel budget and dynamic fuel management accounting for inventory, time to resupply, and expected renewables.
decisions.current_documented_requirement: Qualitative goal to reduce fuel reliance; no numerical ceiling specified.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: No fuel budget ceiling or seasonal liter constraint in milp.py or configs.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Station fuel tank storage volume, resupply delivery interval, and seasonal liter allocation.
decisions.validation_required: Station logistics audit of fuel storage capacity and resupply schedule reliability.
decisions.future_specification_required: Specify seasonal fuel budget constraint equations and dynamic fuel tracking KPIs.

decisions.title: Minimize Avoidable Renewable Curtailment (No Arbitrary % Target)
decisions.policy_intent: Maximize renewable utilization by avoiding unnecessary curtailment. Curtailment permitted only for reliability, storage, or generator safety.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Zero marginal solar cost in MILP; no explicit renewable utilization KPI.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Tracking KPI formulation for avoidable vs unavoidable curtailment.
decisions.validation_required: Site solar irradiance and wind availability telemetry integration.
decisions.future_specification_required: Formulate renewable utilization objective term penalizing avoidable curtailment.

decisions.title: Necessary Renewable Curtailment Allowed Without Explicit Penalty
decisions.policy_intent: Necessary renewable curtailment required for battery protection or generator stability is allowed without an objective penalty.
decisions.current_documented_requirement: Qualitative goal to utilize renewables; no curtailment policy specified.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: P_pv_curtail is unpenalized in milp.py (implementation fact, NOT policy).
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Mathematical distinction between necessary spill curtailment and avoidable economic curtailment.
decisions.validation_required: Control controller validation of minimum generator loading and battery max charge rates.
decisions.future_specification_required: Specify curtailment balance equation leaving necessary spill unpenalized.

decisions.title: Dynamic Emergency Reserve with Baseline Reserve Floor
decisions.policy_intent: Maintain dynamic emergency reserve adapting to forecast risk, plus a dedicated baseline reserve floor above technical minimum SOC.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: soc_min = 0.20 (20% SOC) technical cell protection floor in battery.yaml.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact numerical baseline reserve floor % SOC and dynamic risk-adjustment equations.
decisions.validation_required: Battery vendor degradation testing to confirm usable SOC range above 20% floor.
decisions.future_specification_required: Formulate dynamic emergency BESS reserve constraints and baseline reserve floor equation.

decisions.title: Dynamic Terminal SOC Requirement with Minimum SOC Floor
decisions.policy_intent: End-of-horizon SOC governed by dynamic requirement adapting to upcoming risk, plus a minimum terminal SOC floor.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: SOC_terminal unconstrained at horizon boundary in milp.py.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact numerical minimum terminal SOC floor % and dynamic horizon-end SOC target formulation.
decisions.validation_required: Multi-day rolling MPC simulations to verify inter-day storage continuity.
decisions.future_specification_required: Specify dynamic terminal SOC constraints at horizon boundary end-step.

decisions.title: Deterministic Safety Margins with Real-Time MPC Feedback Correction
decisions.policy_intent: Account for forecast uncertainty using deterministic safety margins combined with real-time rolling MPC feedback correction.
decisions.current_documented_requirement: Qualitative goal to 'mitigate solar forecast uncertainty'.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Deterministic MILP optimization over point forecast in milp.py.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact numerical solar, wind, and demand uncertainty margin percentages.
decisions.validation_required: Statistical analysis of historical station solar, wind, and load forecast errors.
decisions.future_specification_required: Formulate deterministic safety reserve margins and specify real-time MPC feedback execution frequency.

decisions.title: Reliability Absolute Priority; Fuel Minimized Subject to Reliability & Budget
decisions.policy_intent: Critical reliability has absolute priority. Fuel minimized subject to reliability SLA and fuel budget limits. Critical load never sacrificed for fuel.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: 16,000:1 objective cost ratio ($10,000/$0.625) & ~0.3716 L/kWh empirical V2 ratio.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact mathematical formulation of Stage-1 hard reliability vs Stage-2 fuel minimization.
decisions.validation_required: Mathematical proof and MILP solver verification of lexicographic dominance.
decisions.future_specification_required: Construct multi-stage lexicographic objective function enforcing absolute reliability dominance over fuel.

decisions.title: Strict Lexicographic Priority Structure (Reliability -> Resilience -> Fuel -> Renewables)
decisions.policy_intent: 1. Critical reliability -> 2. Emergency battery reserve / resilience -> 3. Fuel conservation -> 4. Renewable utilization.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Single composite scalar weighted objective function in milp.py.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Exact mathematical multi-stage solver formulation implementing 4-tier lexicographic priority.
decisions.validation_required: Solver execution benchmark across 4-stage lexicographic optimization problems.

decisions.title: Multi-Tier Governance Approval Structure
decisions.policy_intent: Three distinct approval tiers: 1. Technical validation, 2. Mission / operations validation, 3. Final policy approval.
decisions.current_implementation_fact: Ad-hoc engineering development choices in prototype scripts.
decisions.unresolved_parameter: Named organizational individuals and board positions assigned to each approval tier.
decisions.future_specification_required: Specify change control protocol, technical review board workflow, and sign-off archiving.
